Bramwell Hydraulics
BH-250
250 t hydraulic press
Service Manual
Revision 3
For qualified maintenance personnel


1 Safety
1.1 General safety
Only qualified maintenance personnel who have read this manual may service the BH-250. Keep hands and tools out
of the die space while the pump runs. Fit the safety blocks under the ram before you work beneath it. Wear safety
glasses and oil-resistant gloves, and clean up spilled oil at once.
1.2 Lockout and tagout
Before you work on the hydraulic system, stop the pump, switch off the main isolator and fit your personal lock and
tag. The system keeps stored hydraulic energy in the accumulator after the pump stops, so bleed the accumulator
until its gauge reads 0 bar before you open any line. Lower the ram onto blocks and verify zero energy before you
start.
Bramwell Hydraulics BH-250 Service Manual, Revision 3

4 Procedures
4.1 Replace main cylinder seal kit
Plant ref: PROC-HP-04 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 180 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Lower the ram onto blocks, stop the pump and apply lockout and tagout on the main isolator.
 2. Bleed stored pressure from the accumulator until the gauge reads 0 bar.
 3. Remove the cylinder gland and pull out the old seals.
 4. Fit the SEAL-KIT-50 seals in the order shown in figure 4.
 5. Refit the gland and top up the oil with OIL-HLP46-20L.
 6. Remove the lockout, cycle the press 10 times at low pressure and check for leaks.

rod seal
guide ring
piston seal

4.2 Change hydraulic oil and filter
Plant ref: PROC-HP-05 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 120 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Stop the pump, apply lockout and tagout, and bleed the accumulator to 0 bar.
 2. Drain the tank and wipe out the sludge.
 3. Replace the return filter with FLT-HYD-10.
 4. Refill with OIL-HLP46-20L to the upper sight-glass mark.
 5. Run the pump unloaded for 10 minutes and take an oil sample.

Page 5


4.3 Reset and test relief valve
Plant ref: PROC-HP-06 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 60 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Stop the pump, apply lockout and tagout, and bleed the accumulator to 0 bar.
 2. Remove the relief valve cap and replace the seal with SEAL-RV-25.
 3. Remove the lockout and set the valve to 210 bar with the test gauge.
 4. Lock the adjuster and record the setting.
 
Order no.
Description
Qty

Relief valve seal kit
